claim: VCO frequency-vs-VCTRL characterization for design/vco/vco_ring5.sch (the standalone current-starved 5-stage ring VCO, issue #24), measured at six VCTRL points from 0.8 V to 1.6 V, matching design/vco/DESIGN.md's own informal sanity-check table (issue #52). This is a measured design-input record, not a spec claim: it replaces that informal, uncommitted, single-corner sanity check with real committed sim/ evidence, so a future decision record has something citable to argue spec/target-spec.md row 2 (output band) and row 5 (Kvco) from. It ratifies nothing -- per CLAUDE.md, ratification is a separate decision-record act argued on its own merits. The PVT grid this manifest declares is the DR-003-ratified sky130 5-corner set (tt/ff/ss/sf/fs x -40/27/125 degC) crossed with spec/target-spec.md row 1's ratified supply range (1.62/1.80/1.98 V) -- see spec/decision-records/DR-003-corner-and-temperature-scope.md, which supersedes the tt/ss/ff-only convention this manifest originally declared -- a given record's own **Corner matrix run** field states whether it covers that full 45-point grid or a declared subset, per sim/README.md's subset-justification rule.
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/vco/vco_ring5.sch driven open-loop (no PFD, charge pump, loop filter or divider in the path) -- it characterizes the VCO block alone, not the closed loop, which is sim/pll's job. The six VCTRL values match design/vco/DESIGN.md's own informal sanity-check table, so this record is directly comparable to it; a swept value where the ring does not free-run is recorded as data (the edge of the range) rather than as a failure, and the per-point verdict requires at least three of the six to oscillate. Each swept point is a fresh 200 ns transient started from RING0 forced low with `uic`, because a noiseless simulator will otherwise sit on the ring's unstable all-stages-at-midrail DC equilibrium indefinitely; the first 60 ns are discarded as startup. The reported slope is an endpoint-to-endpoint mean across the whole swept range, not a local small-signal Kvco, and the curve is strongly non-linear -- read the per-swept-value table for the shape. process_corners is the ratified rows 19/20 PVT grid (spec/target-spec.md, DR-003, #77) -- sky130's five standard MOS/BJT process corners including the two mixed-skew corners (sf, fs) that stress this design's un-cascoded PFD/charge-pump UP/DN current mirror -- not a bare local convention, following sim/pll's own tb.json (PR #86).
analysis: transient per swept VCTRL value (`tran 50p 200n uic`, six values, one ngspice invocation per PVT point)
